verdict.rationale: Perplexity Sonar API is not itself an agent but a service/API, so this axis applies; docs clearly document an official MCP server, both a Perplexity-hosted remote endpoint (api.perplexity.ai/mcp) and a local stdio server, plus tool-restriction configuration, allowing agents to connect via MCP. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on third-party confirmation of the MCP server working in practice beyond first-party docs.
